FM07.reasoning: The agent uses the raw features as-is without attempting any derived features, domain-informed transformations, or encoding, which leaves potential predictive signal unexploited.

other_failure_modes.name: Execution failure due to unencoded categorical variables
other_failure_modes.description: The agent passes raw data to StandardScaler without encoding the categorical string variables present in the dataset (X0-X8), which will cause a ValueError during execution.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies feature scaling and imputation on the entire training dataset before performing the K-Fold split, causing statistical information from the validation folds to leak into the training folds.

other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage during imputation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using the mean of the test set itself, rather than using the mean learned from the training set, which is a form of data leakage.

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation. However, the code will critically fail to execute because categorical string variables are passed directly to `StandardScaler` without prior encoding. Furthermore, the solution suffers from data leakage because scaling is performed before the CV split, and test set missing values are incorrectly imputed using test set means rather than train set means.
